customer_acct_42: Hey team — hitting intermittent failures and huge latency on our embeddings endpoint. When we send batched inputs we sometimes get an error 'Dimension mismatch: expected 1024 but got 1536' and other times the call just hangs for 10s+. Request id in logs: rwid-8a3f7c. Happened from our Python client doing batch size 8.

customer_acct_42: Quick repro snippet (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-rw-request-id: rwid-8a3f7c' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":["doc1","doc2", ... ]}'
```

sophie (Support): Thanks for the report — really sorry for the interruption. I’m triaging now. Two quick asks: can you paste the exact payload shape you sent (number of items and whether you pre-computed any vectors client-side) and confirm whether you set any custom batcher on your client? Also I’ll ping observability/eng for traces.

sophie (Support): @marta @kai FYI — customer sees dimension mismatch (1024 vs 1536) on embeddings + latency spikes for batched requests, request id rwid-8a3f7c. Could you look into trace/span breakdown and whether a new model variant rolled out?

support-bot: New ticket created: #INC-2026-1134 for rwid-8a3f7c — assigned to support queue.

marta (Observability): Looking now. From the tracing backend I can see the trace for rwid-8a3f7c. High-level breakdown:
- frontend routing: 30ms
- auth/tenant check: 12ms
- request deserialization + batching logic: 20ms
- model.inference span: 8.5s (dominant)
- postprocess/encode: 40ms
Total ~8.6s. There are repeated traces for the same request id with different outcomes (sometimes 400).

marta (Observability): Query I used in tracing UI: `service:embeddings and trace.request_id:"rwid-8a3f7c"` — then expanded spans. The model.inference span shows variable payload sizes and a recurring warning in logs: `embedding_vector_len_mismatch`.

marta (Observability): Dashboard panels you can check: Console -> Observability -> API Routes -> /v1/embeddings (p50/p95/p99), and Trace Explorer -> span name contains `model.inference` to see per-request timing. I also checked our internal metrics: error rate for embeddings endpoint spiked from 0.2% to 3.7% in that 10m window.

kai (Eng-ML): Thanks @marta. Dimension mismatch implies the model selector or the client is sending vectors that don't match the model's output dim. `text-embedding-3-large` should produce 1536 dims and `text-embedding-3-small` 1024 (example numbers). The error text reported by customer said expected 1024 but got 1536 — that suggests the server expected small but received large. Two hypotheses:
1) The customer’s tenant is pinned to an older model variant with 1024 dim while their client requested `text-embedding-3-large`.
2) The client is accidentally concatenating precomputed vectors into the batch (client-side bug) and passing arrays of arrays, causing shape mismatch at the server bundler.

kai (Eng-ML): @sophie can you confirm the `model` field in the customer's payload? If they left it blank, we may route to a tenant-default. Also ask them to attach the full request headers + payload for one failing call.

customer_acct_42: We always set `model: "text-embedding-3-large"` in the payload. Code doing the batching (simplified):
```python
# using numpy to prepare batch
batch = []
for doc in docs:
    emb = client.embed(doc)
    batch.append(emb)
batch_payload = np.stack(batch)
# send JSON with list(batch_payload)
```
We do pre-embed some chunks for efficiency (embedding paragraphs then sending several to server in one shot).

kai (Eng-ML): That snippet is the smoking gun — looks like you're pre-embedding (client-side) then sending those vectors back to the embeddings endpoint, which expects raw text not vectors. If those pre-embeds were produced by a different model (small vs large) the server-side concatenation will detect dim mismatch or route incorrectly. Two options: send raw text for server embeddings, or if you want to store and re-send vectors, use the embeddings import path (not /v1/embeddings), or ensure the dimensions match and use our vector upsert API (enterprise).

sophie (Support): Ok this explains the dimension errors. What about the latency spikes? Marta, the model.inference span is 8.5s for some requests — is that due to batching behavior?

marta (Observability): Yes. Traces show large model batch sizes (server side) when client sends many inputs at once — but also a couple of traces where the batcher attempted to coalesce precomputed vectors with textual inputs, triggering fallback and a longer path (extra validation + conversion attempts), which pushed inference into slower code paths. I created a temporary filter in the dashboard to show `batch_size >= 16` and those had 95th latencies way higher.

marta (Observability): Queries you can run in Console Logs: 
```sql
select timestamp, request_id, model_name, batch_size, latency_ms, error_code
from traces
where request_id = 'rwid-8a3f7c'
order by timestamp desc
```
That will show full sequence for the request id.

kai (Eng-ML): Action items:
- I’ll push a server guard to reject payloads that mix raw text and numeric vectors with a clear 400 message.
- Add better validation message: `400 Bad Request — embeddings payload contains numeric vectors but endpoint expects raw text. Use /v1/vectors/import for precomputed vectors.`
- Instrument the batcher to emit `batch_coalesce_type` tag so we can filter these in traces.

kai (Eng-ML): I deployed a small change to the validation layer and a canary at 10:23 UTC. It will return explicit 400s instead of hitting the slow fallback.

support-bot: Deployment success: canary/embeddings-validation v1.3.2 rolled to 10% at 2026-02-14T10:23:00Z.

sophie (Support): Customer — can you re-run the failing call now? We added clearer rejection so it should fail fast with 400 instead of timing out.

customer_acct_42: Re-ran it. Got 400 + message `embeddings payload contains numeric vectors but endpoint expects raw text`. Much better — no 8s hang. Thanks.

sophie (Support): Great. For long-term: we recommend either (A) stop pre-embedding before calling /v1/embeddings, or (B) use our vector import API if you want to upsert vectors. I’ll document this in your ticket and include suggested client-side checks (ensure all inputs are strings, validate np.ndarray dims before sending).

marta (Observability): Follow-up I added two dashboard panels: 1) Embeddings: Request type (raw_text vs numeric_vector) breakdown and 2) Batch size vs p95 latency. Both are under Console -> Observability -> Saved Dashboards -> Embeddings Ops. I also flagged traces that show `batch_coalesce_type=mixed` to the eng-runtime queue.

kai (Eng-ML): I’ll open a small client-side example in our docs showing correct batching for text-only requests and a snippet that rejects mixed lists.

customer_acct_42: Verified all green on our side. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. :tada:

sophie (Support): Closing the loop here — PR for better validation merged, dashboards updated, customer confirmed fix. Closing ticket #INC-2026-1134. If you see anything else ping us. :thumbsup:
